preview: Jamaica Kingsmen face Guyana Amazon Warriors in CPL 2026 Match 6 at Sabina Park. The match is scheduled for Thu 13 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. Guyana retain Shimron Hetmyer, Romario Shepherd, Shai Hope and Shamar Joseph, while 10 of their 12 locally selected players come from Guyana. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
